resources.string: Managed by this device; model templates keep it unchanged
Adjust audio, display, steering wheel controls and the car display
Confirm your choice, then tap Save on the configuration page.
Editing settings keeps the current connection running.
IPv4 only by default. Save the vehicle profile to apply this on the next Wi-Fi Direct connection.

Built-in configurations start a new file and keep existing files. Selecting a user file uses that file. Switching discards unsaved edits. Connection settings, app settings, authentication and logs are kept.
Saved · The current connection keeps its settings; changes apply next time
Adjust language, interface size and appearance
Language, interface, icon and button sizes and appearance are saved separately from vehicle templates and included with uploaded logs.
Built-in configurations are read-only starting points for new files. User files can be selected and saved in place.
Enter the car hotspot name and password. Leave the password blank for an open hotspot; other settings are automatic.
Keep the defaults for everyday use. Adjust these only when changing authentication methods.
Avoid Bluetooth music playing alongside CarPlay.

Restore default audio, controls, reporting and display parameters for %1$s, replacing saved preferences and unsaved edits. Connection settings, app settings, local authentication material and logs are kept. The current connection continues; defaults apply on the next connection.
Forward supported media and voice keys. Record unknown keys step by step in Debug; mappings are not guessed. Changes apply on the next connection.
Report music and media to the car

Send phone music and navigation information to the car display when supported. Enabling a switch does not confirm system acceptance; use Debug for guided verification. Changes apply on the next connection.
Built-in configurations cannot be overwritten. Edit parameters, then create and name a user file. The current connection configuration is kept.
Create and use a separate user file. The built-in configuration and existing files are kept.
Confirm to create and use a user file. Built-in configurations and existing files are kept. Duplicate names are not overwritten.
This new file has not been saved. Check its parameters, then create and name the file. The original file is kept.
